textures.prompt:
Fine straight-grain light hardwood surface with subtle elongated pores and understated natural grain. Grain runs horizontally, parallel to U. No planks, joints, knots larger than a few millimetres, end grain, seams or carved detail.

Target base color sRGB #DBC29B, with restrained microscopic contrast. Entire tile covers approximately 0.6 by 0.6 metres.

Seamless base-color albedo, exactly straight-on and full frame. Flat material reflectance, no directional light, highlights, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, gradient, vignette, perspective or depth. No object silhouette, border, room, floor, wall, text or watermark. All four edges tile continuously. Opaque RGB. Geometry, roughness and lighting are supplied separately by the renderer.
textures.processing: Routine 128px RGB BOX downsample only. Original color samples retained; material code computes neutral luminance modulation at runtime, independently from authored normals.
